## Project Introduction

For our Introduction to Engineering course at the University of Arkansas, our team designed and built a balsa wood tower with a 15-gram mass limit. We wanted to make the structure as strong as possible while staying within the material limit.

## Project Objective

Our goal was to balance strength and weight by planning how much balsa wood and glue we could use before building and testing the tower.

## What We Did

- Designed and constructed a balsa wood tower.
- Worked within a total mass limit of 15 grams.
- Measured 15 balsa wood sticks to estimate material properties.
- Used Excel to analyze linear density and plan the mass budget for wood and glue.
- Calculated how much usable material was available.
- Tested the structure under increasing loads to evaluate its performance.

## My Role

I helped with the design, construction, and testing. I also worked on the Excel calculations to decide how we could use our limited materials efficiently.

## What We Learned

This project helped us understand the tradeoffs between strength, weight, and material usage. We also gained experience using Excel to guide engineering decisions and working together to test a design.
